Short title and commencement

THE DORMANT FUNDS (ADMINISTRATION), ACT, 1966
THE DORMANT FUNDS (ADMINISTRATION), ACT, 1966
ACT No. XX of 1966
(For Statement of objects and Reasons, see
Gaz. of P., 1966, Ext., p. 620 (R.),)
[19th December, 1966]
An Act to provide for the administration of certain dormant funds and
matters connected therewith
WHEREAS certain funds raised by
public subscriptions and donations have been lying dormant ;
AND WHEREAS it is expedient to
make provision for the administration and proper utilization and disposal of
those funds ;
AND WHEREAS the national interest
of Pakistan in relation to the achievement of uniformity within the meaning of
clause (2) of Article 131 of the Constitution requires Central Legislation in
the matter ;
It is hereby enacted as follows
:-
1. Short title and commencement.-(1) This Act may be called the
Dormant Funds (Ad ministration) Act, 1966.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.

Vesting of dormant funds in the President and their untilisation

An Act to provide for the administration of certain dormant funds and
matters connected therewith
WHEREAS certain funds raised by
public subscriptions and donations have been lying dormant ;
AND WHEREAS it is expedient to
make provision for the administration and proper utilization and disposal of
those funds ;
AND WHEREAS the national interest
of Pakistan in relation to the achievement of uniformity within the meaning of
clause (2) of Article 131 of the Constitution requires Central Legislation in
the matter ;
It is hereby enacted as follows
:-
2. Vesting of dormant funds in the President and their untilisation.-(1)
Notwithstanding anything contained in any other law or instrument, the funds
specified in the Schedule, together d with interest and profit accruing
thereon, shall vest forthwith in the President.
(2) The amounts in the aforesaid
funds, other than that in the Palestine Aid Fund, shall be transferred to the
President's Relief Fund instituted on the 16th May, 1965, and shall be utilised
for purposes of relief or for purposes as nearly as possible, to those for
which they were raised.
(3) The amount in the Palestine
Aid Fund shall be utilised for the Palestine cause.
